body:
This DIY Crystal Bracelet Kit is designed to kickstart your gemstone jewelry-making journey! It includes a length of elastic stretch cord for your bands, a threading needle, glue to seal your knots, 50 crystal beads, and two stamped metal Energy Muse logo beads. Not sure how to get started? Your kit also comes with a scannable QR code that links to a video that will guide you step by step through the crafting process.

Your assortment of 50 crystal beads will include the following stones:

  • Red Jasper: Action, motivation, stability
  • Carnelian: Passion, creativity, confidence
  • Citrine: Happiness, abundance, light
  • Aventurine: Luck, success, optimism
  • Rose Quartz: Love, harmony, acceptance
  • Amethyst: Intuition, spiritual growth, peace
  • Pyrite: Abundance, success, prosperity
  • Clear Quartz: Clarity, amplification, focus
  • Amazonite: Hope, optimism, soothing
  • Sodalite: Communication, harmony, calm
  • Garnet: Passion, removes blockages, life force energy
  • Black Agate: Protection, shielding, repels negativity
  • Hematite: Grounding, stability, strength
  • Tiger's Eye: Courage, luck, power
  • Picture Jasper: Rootedness, breath, connection
